title: Pro-Dex Inc (PDEX) Positioned to Strengthen with Zimmer’s mBos Robot Commercialization

content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Mon, August 10, 2026 at 8:46 AM PDT 3 min read

Long Cast Advisers, an independent registered investment adviser, released its Q2 2026 investor letter. A copy can be downloaded here. The firm reported strong earnings in the second quarter, with results improving 20%, bringing year-to-date returns to +19%. While performance trailed the Russell 2000 and iShares US MicroCap ETF, it remained well ahead of the iShares SmallCap EAFE (ex-N. Am) ETF. Since inception in 2015, cumulative returns stand at 343% (15% CAGR), reflecting the firm's strategy of concentrated, patient investments in small and micro‑cap companies. The firm remains cautious in this environment, emphasizing patience and endurance while avoiding margin and volatility. In addition, please check the firm's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

In its Q2 2026 investor letter, Long Cast Advisers highlighted Pro-Dex, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDEX). Pro-Dex, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDEX) is a global medical device company that designs, develops, manufactures, and sells powered surgical instruments for medical device OEMs. On August 7, 2026, Pro-Dex, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDEX) closed at $65.56 per share. The one-month return of Pro-Dex, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDEX) was 7.88%, and its shares gained 72.87% over the past 52 weeks. Pro-Dex, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDEX) has a market capitalization of $209.32 million.

Long Cast Advisers stated the following regarding Pro-Dex, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDEX) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"In 2Q26, Pro-Dex, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDEX), PESI and MTRX were the largest contributors. The PDEX pitch offered an attempt to quantify the anticipated incremental benefits to operations if Zimmer succeeds with the mBos robot commercialization (a corrected version of the slide is below). The milestones, prices and margins are all derived from public filings and we assume four effectors per system sale, as an informed estimate.

Zimmer's purchase of Monogram last year included "contingent valuation rights" (CVRs) that pay out $3.41 / share in each year from 2028 to 2030 that mBos gross revenues exceed certain hurdles. Based on these estimates, we calculated the number of systems needed to achieve those revenues, and it triangulates to a capital sale in the range of ~$1M per machine, in line with the cost of Stryker's Mako platform. Stryker sold 860 units in its first three years, so the forecast 609 units to trigger the final CVR seems achievable. And even if the timing is wrong or our estimates imprecise, as long as the direction is right - and Zimmer is putting significant resources behind the launch - once the system launches, PDEX could experience an exceptional transformation in operating cash flow that would justify a substantially higher corporate value. This is why it remains a top position."

Long Cast Advisers 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信中重点介绍了 Pro-Dex, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PDEX）。 Pro-Dex, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PDEX）是一家全球医疗器械公司，为医疗器械 OEM 设计、开发、制造和销售动力手术器械。 2026 年 8 月 7 日，Pro-Dex, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PDEX）收于每股 65.56 美元。 Pro-Dex, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PDEX）的一个月回报率为7.88%，其股价在过去52周内上涨了72.87%。 Pro-Dex, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PDEX）的市值为 2.0932 亿美元。

Long Cast Advisers 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就 Pro-Dex, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PDEX）发表了以下声明：

“2026 年第二季度，Pro-Dex, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：PDEX）、PESI 和 MTRX 是最大的贡献者。 PDEX 推介尝试量化如果 Zimmer 成功实现 mBos 机器人商业化，预计将给运营带来的增量效益（幻灯片的修正版本如下）。 里程碑、价格和利润均来自公开文件，作为明智的估计，我们假设每个系统销售有四个效应器。 Zimmer 去年对 Monogram 的收购包括“或有估值权”(CVR)，从 2028 年到 2030 年，如果 mBo 总收入超过一定门槛，每年将支付 3.41 美元/股。 根据这些估计，我们计算了实现这些收入所需的系统数量，并根据 Stryker Mako 平台的成本得出每台机器约 100 万美元的资本销售范围。 Stryker 在前三年售出了 860 台，因此预计 609 台触发最终 CVR 似乎可以实现。 即使时机错误或我们的估计不精确，只要方向正确 - 并且 Zimmer 正在为启动投入大量资源 - 一旦系统启动，PDEX 可能会经历运营现金流的特殊转变，这将证明公司价值大幅提高是合理的。 这就是为什么它仍然处于领先地位。”
